evidence_quotes: de watervergunning voor het lozen van effluent, afkomstig van de integrale afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallatie (IAZI) van Sitech, gewijzigd.
rationale: The Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision concerns the amendment by the executive board (dagelijks bestuur) of a water permit (watervergunning) for discharging effluent from Sitech's integrated wastewater treatment plant (IAZI). Wastewater discharge licensing under a watervergunning falls squarely within WATER and the regulatory_permit category.
